faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Expand a question below to read the full answer.

items.question: Is Amatdda free?
items.answer: Yes. Core features are free. Some screens may include ads to help run the service.

items.question: Where is my data stored?
items.answer: What you enter in the app and on the web is tied to your account and stored securely on our servers with sync. Some parts may be limited when you're offline.

items.question: What's the difference between the app and the web (PC browser)?
items.answer: The web is great for quick checks and edits on a PC. The iOS and Android apps are best for push notifications, home screen widgets, and other device-native features. Use the same account for the smoothest experience.

items.question: What can I do with the timetable feature?
items.answer: Build a weekly grid with periods or time blocks, and add subjects, places, and notes. Handy for a semester view or alongside your routines.

items.question: Can I see the same data on multiple devices?
items.answer: Yes, when you're signed in with the same account on iOS, Android, and the web. Make sure each device stays logged in.

items.question: Why does the web show a preview or limited mode?
items.answer: If you're not signed in, or a feature needs a link with the app, it may be restricted. Sign in and connect from the app, then reopen the web to continue with the same data.
